title: Photochemistry Reaction Lab: Light-Driven Flower Pigment Synthesis
description: The user operates a barn lamp as an adjustable UV/visible light source to drive a photochemical pigment synthesis reaction inside a glass vase containing flowers. By tuning wavelength, intensity, exposure duration, and catalyst concentration, the user must synthesize five target pigment colors in sequence, watching the flowers and liquid in the vase change color in real time as the reaction proceeds.
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap with cdn.jsdelivr.net) implementing a photochemistry lab simulation. Load AnisotropyBarnLamp.glb positioned at (-2, 2, 0) aimed toward the center, and GlassVaseFlowers.glb at (0, 0, 0). The lamp represents an adjustable electromagnetic radiation source and the glass vase acts as the reaction vessel.

Camera: PerspectiveCamera at (3, 3, 5) with OrbitControls, looking at origin. Add ambient light (0.15 intensity) and a point light parented to the lamp model that changes color based on selected wavelength.

UI Panel (HTML overlay, top-right): Four sliders — Wavelength (380-780nm, colored track), Intensity (0-100%), Exposure Time (1-60 seconds with a Start Exposure button), and Catalyst Concentration (0-5 mol/L). Display current reaction status and a target pigment color swatch.

Interaction flow (7 steps with validation): The system presents 5 sequential target pigment colors (deep violet, emerald green, golden yellow, crimson red, cyan blue). For each target, the user must set wavelength within ±20nm of the correct value, intensity within ±10% of required value, catalyst concentration within ±0.5 mol/L, then press Start Exposure. Validate all parameters before the reaction proceeds. During exposure, animate a visible light beam (cylinder geometry with emissive material) from the lamp to the vase, and gradually tint the flowers and vase liquid (use material.color.lerp) toward the target color over the exposure duration. Show a progress bar during exposure. After each successful synthesis, display a checkmark and advance to the next target. If parameters are out of range, flash the invalid slider red and show an error tooltip explaining which parameter needs adjustment. After all 5 pigments are synthesized, show a completion banner with total time taken. Add particle effects (small glowing spheres) inside the vase during active reactions to represent molecular excitation.
